strategies.name: Opponent-adjusted margin / moneyline
strategies.hypothesis: Shrink team strength toward league mean; fit point differential using lagged offense/defense, home field and opponent strength.
strategies.output: Distribution of home margin; derive spread cover and moneyline from the same coherent score distribution.
strategies.risk: Win percentage is NOT a matchup win probability. Full-season aggregates may seed a later season only, never earlier games.

strategies.name: Total points (offense vs defense)
strategies.hypothesis: Forecast both teams' points using passing efficiency (yards/attempt, rating) and points for/against; allow residuals to co-move.
strategies.output: Expected total and calibrated distribution at the offered total; overtime/push handling per operator contract.
strategies.risk: Adding historical PF+PA is not an opponent-adjusted total model. Passing-only snapshot omits rushing/scoring.

strategies.name: Schedule & availability update
strategies.hypothesis: Fit rest, bye and travel effects as covariates; timestamp official injury reports and roster changes at a fixed pregame cutoff.
strategies.output: Update score/participation distributions at cutoff; abstain when material availability is unknown.
strategies.risk: Schedule rows not transcribed; injury snapshot is bounded (4 teams). Do not use final participation as a pregame feature.

strategies.name: QB passing distribution
strategies.hypothesis: Model attempts, completion rate and yards/attempt separately; shrink rates and include opponent pass-defense context.
strategies.output: P(passing yards > offered line), P(push), and fair decimal price under the documented participation/void contract.
strategies.risk: Season totals are not a prop distribution; top-25 passing subset is biased. Injury probabilities remain blank without data.

strategies.name: Rushing / receiving distribution
strategies.hypothesis: Model touches, opportunities and conversion with overdispersion; check calibration separately for each market.
strategies.output: Full predictive count/yard distribution; component totals need the joint distribution, not summed independent variances.
strategies.risk: Rushing/receiving header labels not rendered — positional only. No sign assumed; role/threshold drift likely.

strategies.name: Cross-game joint-value filter
strategies.hypothesis: Start from independently validated single-game probabilities; estimate shared-day/team uncertainty and test dependence.
strategies.output: Joint win probability vs the actual operator's combined executable quote; disclose every leg and exposure cluster.
strategies.risk: Different games do NOT automatically mean independence. Product of individual odds is not a verified combined payout.

strategies.name: Same-player passing + rushing/receiving
strategies.hypothesis: Use aligned game-level outcomes and frozen thresholds; validate joint hit probabilities on later games.
strategies.output: Estimate joint hits directly or use a calibrated joint simulation; compare with a same-contract combo quote.
strategies.risk: No game logs collected. Raw-stat correlation does not guarantee threshold-event correlation.

strategies.name: Teammate / team-total combination
strategies.hypothesis: Simulate shared play volume, snaps, targets and game script; fit conditional residual dependence.
strategies.output: Joint probability of all requested legs; use the operator's offered settlement and void matrix.
strategies.risk: No presumption that teammates are positively or negatively correlated. Pairwise correlations cannot identify a 3+ leg distribution.

gates.name: Provenance & contract
gates.pass_rule: Official-source receipts for every datum, original publication/capture time, dataset hashes, exact market/line/operator and settlement rules. URL presence is insufficient.
gates.current: Stats snapshots checked; pregame quotes and contracts missing.

gates.name: Temporal integrity
gates.pass_rule: Freeze features, model, selection and calibration before kickoff; join using available_at <= cutoff; purged calendar walk-forward folds group every game's legs.
gates.current: No contemporaneous pregame record or sealed test exists.

gates.name: Coverage & power
gates.pass_rule: Screen at 500 settled selections, 200 distinct games, 60 dates, plus a predeclared power calculation and missingness/selection-bias audit. Numbers are project policy, not proof of skill.
gates.current: Season aggregates only; no market selections or power study.

gates.name: Forecast quality
gates.pass_rule: On a common untouched event universe; beat frozen simple and same-contract de-vigged-market baselines in proper scores; inspect reliability.
gates.current: No forecast evaluation; no market baseline.

gates.name: Joint dependence
gates.pass_rule: Aligned event pairs, n/date/CI, conditional residual study, feasible marginals/joint probabilities and held-out joint calibration.
gates.current: Descriptive cross-sectional estimates only; no executable combo evidence. Explicitly N/A for singles with an artifact, not a pass.

gates.name: Executable economics
gates.pass_rule: Actual timely quote, offered market, costs/limits, full push/void/overtime/DNP settlement and same-contract close.

gates.name: Uncertainty & robustness
gates.pass_rule: Net return lower 95% date-block interval >0 after costs; drawdown, coverage, CLV, block/season sensitivity.
gates.current: ROI, CLV and return intervals blank. CLV alone would not establish skill.

gates.name: Selection / multiple testing
gates.pass_rule: Every attempted variant logged; valid preregistered null tests; Holm familywise alpha=0.05 over the full family.
gates.current: No confirmatory test family or p-values.

gates.name: Forward shadow & risk
gates.pass_rule: Freeze common future evaluation; at least 60 calendar days and 200 games; paper caps and abstention log.
gates.current: No prospective record; cash execution disabled.

gates.name: Reproducibility & rights
gates.pass_rule: Reproduce hashes, probabilities, settlement and scores; establish source rights/operator/contest permissions.
gates.current: Reproduction supported. NFL Terms non-commercial + gambling-use restrictions confirmed; separate permission absent.
